groups.name: Annotation popup: selection to queued prompts
groups.rationale: Captures text selections within diff blocks, renders a popup with preview and comment box, and converts the selection and comment into queued annotation prompts.

groups.name: Conversation panel: queued and delivered prompts
groups.rationale: Renders queued annotations as removable pills and delivered conversation as entries with author roles, with a general comment box and send buttons that differ based on session status.

groups.name: Panel and diff mounting with event-driven updates
groups.rationale: Refactors the entry point to mount the diff view, conversation panel, and annotation popup as separate subsystems, and wires them to update together when the server sends a re-group event.

groups.name: Styling for popup, panel, and form controls
groups.rationale: Adds CSS for the annotation popup, conversation panel pills, and shared form element styles, following the lavish editor design.

groups.name: Build and config adjustments
groups.rationale: Moves the browser entry point into a `dom/` subdirectory, updates the build script and TypeScript exclusions to match, and marks completed tasks.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
